topic: q-zone: which zone an entity stands in
method: ilspycmd 11.0.0.9375 (already installed at %TEMP%\codex-ilspy) against the QA profile's interop assemblies (%APPDATA%\r2modmanPlus-local\GTFO\profiles\Forge-MapEditor-QA\BepInEx\interop\Modules-ASM.dll). No game was started; no profile was written.

findings.member: public unsafe virtual AIG_CourseNode CourseNode { get; set; }
findings.wrapper: Il2CppInterop property; the getter is a virtual il2cpp_runtime_invoke and returns null when the native pointer is zero.
findings.why: The player agent and the enemy agent both derive from Agents.Agent, so one member answers 'which course node is this agent on' for both kinds.

findings.member: public unsafe LG_Zone m_zone { get; set; }
findings.wrapper: Il2CppInterop field accessor; null when the node is not placed in a zone.
findings.why: The course node's own zone is the level's answer to 'where is this node'; the responder reads it and nothing else.

findings.member: public unsafe eDimensionIndex m_dimensionIndex; public unsafe LG_Layer m_layer; public unsafe eLocalZoneIndex LocalIndex;
findings.why: These three are exactly the coordinates ForgeMap's ZoneIndex already turns into a map-object address (ForgeMap/Native/ZoneIndex.cs, ZoneIndex.Coordinates): dimension, layer type and the zone's index inside the layer. Reusing them keeps one spelling of a zone, so a zone read by an entity and a zone a plan names are comparable.
The middle coordinate; read through the zone's own m_layer, as ZoneIndex does.

findings.member: public unsafe List<AIG_CourseNode> m_courseNodes; public unsafe LG_NavInfo NavInfo;
findings.why: Not read by the responder: a zone's members are read from each entity's own course node instead, so a level with an unbuilt node list still answers for the entities that have one. Recorded here so the choice is explicit.

derived.derivation: agent.CourseNode.m_zone -> ZoneIndex.Coordinates -> (dimension, layer, zone), formatted by RuntimeZones.Id as `gtfo.zone:<dimension>:<layer>:<zone>`
derived.refusal: A null CourseNode, a null m_zone, a zone whose coordinates do not read, or an entity the module does not currently track answers null, which the kernel reports as entity-zone-unknown. It is never answered as 'outside every zone'.

notVerifiedInGame: That a player's CourseNode is non-null for the whole time it stands in a zone (the hook that attaches the player half is the player spawn readback, which the player identity module already exercises at runtime).
That an enemy's CourseNode is set on the host for every tracked life (the enemy module tracks the agent from its spawn hook; the read is on the same instance it already resolves).
The exact coordinates of a real QA level's zones; the evidence above is type-level and the two coordinate readers are the ones ZoneIndex already uses for door and terminal addresses.
